title: 1995 AHSME Problem 8
statement: In triangle \(ABC,\) \(\angle C=90^\circ,\) \(AC=6\) and \(BC=8.\) Points \(D\) and \(E\) are on \(\overline{AB}\) and \(\overline{BC},\) respectively, and \(\angle BED=90^\circ.\) If \(DE=4,\) then \(BD=\)

solutions.text: The large right triangle has \(AB=\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10.\) Since \(\overline{DE}\parallel\overline{AC},\) triangles \(BDE\) and \(BAC\) are similar, with scale factor \(\frac{DE}{AC}=\frac{4}{6}=\frac{2}{3}.\) Therefore \(BD=(\frac{2}{3})(10)=\frac{20}{3}.\) Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: The two right angles show that \(\overline{DE}\parallel\overline{AC}\)
Use similarity between \(\triangle BDE\) and \(\triangle BAC\)
